_note: The rules an employer's contribution to a recognised provident fund feeds (W-238e). By its condition on employer.fund: PERQ-RPF-CONTRIBUTION charges the contribution beyond its share of salary (1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.6(a)), TY 2025-26 only, so a later year's pack drops it. PERQ-EMPLOYER-CONTRIBUTION adds up every employer contribution to a recognised provident fund, the notified pension scheme and an approved superannuation fund and charges the excess over its limit (S2 s.17(1)(h); 1961 s.17(2)(vii); D-126); PERQ-EMPLOYER-ACCRETION charges the accretion on that excess (S2 s.17(1)(i); 1961 s.17(2)(viia); D-127). Neither reads employer.fund in a condition: EmployerContributionNode reaches both with every contribution (W-238e).
displayName: The employer's contribution to a recognised provident fund

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 s.17(1)(h), (i); Income-tax Act, 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.6(a): as each rule row in feedsInto cites them
provenance.whatToCheck: Open Gazette 265620 at s.17(1)(h) and (i), and the 1961 Act's Sch. IV Pt A r.6(a): confirm each takes the employer's contribution to a recognised provident fund, and that no other provision takes it

terms.terms: The whole balance: on retirement after the age of fifty-five; on retirement for permanent and total incapacity; before migrating abroad; on retrenchment or a voluntary retirement scheme; otherwise on ceasing to be an employee, after twelve months out of covered employment. These are the terms of the fund the EPFO runs; an exempted establishment's fund has its own rules.

provenance.sourceDescription: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 525(E), Gazette Part II s.3(i) No. 473 of 29-06-2026, CG-DL-E-01072026-273957, para. 49(1), (2), p.89

terms.terms: At least one thousand rupees, up to the whole balance above a minimum balance of 25% of all contributions (the employee's and the employer's, with interest), after twelve months' membership: for illness, for education (at most ten times), for marriage (five times), for housing (five times), and in special circumstances (twice in a financial year).

provenance.sourceDescription: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 525(E), Gazette Part II s.3(i) No. 473 of 29-06-2026, CG-DL-E-01072026-273957, para. 46, p.87
